Soul: drops and is collected; blue soul effects are not ported. Sounds: no Aria audio is ported. Animations: its AI is only partly ported (see its enemy row). The linked fire piece now has a provisional 16-by-16 contact box; its native fire callback, bounce timing and sound are still incomplete. State-4 inert visuals now use sub_080CC48C's one-time 32-pixel rise and +0x100 phase each frame, without normal collision. Its sub_0803E058 effect is not yet ported. A lethal hit enters native state 3: 0x6E is requested on death update, then 96- and 128-frame counters and periodic 0x6E requests follow. Sound output, linked visuals and the eight terminal fragments remain absent. The sub_080CBAEC state-2 8-bit idle and 32..63-frame RNG action window now use the original parity and countdown rules; linked-facing and attacks remain missing. Attack range now uses the native inclusive 96x48 window around Buer. State-2 step 1 cycles 80 attack and 32 recovery frames and requests song 0x84 at 72, 63 and 54; paired flames and native sounds in audio output are not implemented. Linked-fire orientation now starts from signed parent velocity, flips at state-2 action-window entry, and controls parent velocity sign at even expiry per sub_080CBA30/sub_080CBAEC; source-derived, but fire effects are missing. Its state-1 movement-to-action gate now follows sub_080CC458/sub_0806DF40's signed room boundary test with the +92-pixel vertical probe. The terrain probe and linked fire behavior remain incomplete. The sub_080CC3C8 linked-fire callback now follows parent coordinates only in child state 0, holds them in subsequent states, and retains the visual during native death stages without contact; the child's actual animations are not yet ported. Buer surviving hits in state 2 now interrupt to the native attack step 1/substep 0 without resetting the byte timer. Fatal hits retain their state-3 death path; associated fire/animation effects remain missing. State-2 idle also detects Soma through the native inclusive 192x48 window only when aligned with the independent linked-fire facing; it preserves the 0xFF timer/RNG race. Terrain probes and flame output remain incomplete. The source-derived sub_080CC20C rolling-facing write is now applied in state 1 and state-2 idle using the signed horizontal speed after the compact movement tick. The attack/recovery stages retain the separate linked facing. Full rolling physics and native fire visuals remain missing. Buer now initializes its separate native +0x18 spin at 0x8000 and integrates the +0x14 angular accumulator on no-contact rolling ticks with the +/-0x4000 friction floor. State-2 idle reverses/halves the spin after rotation; true terrain probes and affine effects remain unported, so animations and audio are still partial. Buer's original +0x18 angular speed is now the sole determinant of rolling linked-flame facing and the signed idle-exit heading. Its provisional +0x48 X translation is independent; native collision impulses and all associated attack flame rendering remain open. A bounded solid-wall branch now rebounds native angular +0x18 spin as -spin/2 using the 24-pixel forward probe. This is not the complete sub_0806CAF8 collision system: floor, slope, 0x20/0x40 flags, true movement and visuals remain incomplete. Source-derived floor-slope contact flags 0x20/0x40 now change angular +0x18 spin by 0x333 toward or away from zero using the spin sign and slope X-flip. The collision table, accurate movement, audiovisual effects and attacks remain incomplete. State-one horizontal translation now derives +0x48 from pre-contact +0x18 spin, with bounded flat-wall and room-front rollback. Native vertical motion, mode-six idle translation and full collision geometry are still unimplemented. State-two idle now conservatively translates horizontal position from pre-contact angular spin only when a flat floor is confirmed; no-ground and forward-wall contact rollback are modeled. Native slope and vertical contact masks remain incomplete. Patch 0663 removes provisional vertical bob during idle mode six and resolves shallow flat-floor penetration; gravity, slopes and native collision visuals remain partial. Attack now accelerates angular spin by 0xCCC and emits paired non-damaging fire visuals on source cadence. Staged death decelerates and rotates, emitting shared flame visuals; native projectiles, eight fragments and full graphics remain partial. Patch 0665 creates the two native-timed independent fire projectile children, with per-variant animation/expiry and horizontal/vertical capped motion, while preserving one parent reward. Projectile hitboxes are conservatively disabled pending native frame collision records; death stage-two horizontal movement now uses pre-contact spin. Patch 0666 adds the native strict +/-0x20000 angular overshoot attack exit and the independent recovery spin/64 rotation with bounded floor slope flags. Sprite, sound, loot, soul and visual parity remain individually partial. Patch 0667 adds an eight-effect final death burst populated only from local ROM-derived offset metadata; no proprietary coordinates are committed. Native affine effect graphics and flame projectile contact remain partial. Patch 0668 adds the death-linked sprite's source 3-tick one-pixel wobble and 16x64 then 64x64 flame scatter with correct pre-motion origins. Visual metadata and projectile hitboxes still require fidelity work.
